description: Instructions for working with Python code using TDD.
applyTo: **/*.py

# Working with Python code.

- As you work with Python code you MUST follow the TDD process as described in [.github/skills/python-development/SKILL.md](../skills/python-development/SKILL.md).
- In case if for any reason you implemented Python code you MUST rollback such changes and implement tests first following the TDD process.
